title: ESA satellite images show damage to two Amazon data centers in Bahrain, supporting Iran's claims last week that it struck the sites; Amazon declined to comment (Olivia Solon/Bloomberg)
summary: Olivia Solon / Bloomberg: ESA satellite images show damage to two Amazon data centers in Bahrain, supporting Iran's claims last week that it struck the sites; Amazon declined to comment — Satellite imagery shows damage to two Amazon.com Inc. data centers in Bahrain, supporting Iran's claims last week that it struck the sites with missiles.
